english.note: Use this more general description when directly calling the clothing revealing rather than stressing that it shows too much.

examples.english: If you wear this top to meet your elders, won’t it feel too revealing?
examples.traditional: 你著呢件衫去見長輩，會唔會覺得太暴露呀？
